tei:div.tei:p: Bestow peace, good fortune, blessing, favour, grace and compassion upon us and upon all Israel Thy people. Bless us, our Father, all of us together through the light of Thy countenance, for through the light of Thy countenance hast Thou given us, O Lord our God, the Torah of life and gracious love, salvation and blessing, mercy, life and peace; and it is good in Thine eyes to bless Thy people Israel at every time and in every hour with Thy peace.

In the book of life, blessing, peace and a good livelihood, may we be remembered and inscribed before Thee, we and all Thy people the house of Israel for a good life and for peace. Blessed art Thou, O Lord who makes peace.
